IT-4402                                                                                                                 about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 17-Jun-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  MACHINE LEARNING [IT-4402]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Identify three common issues found in raw datasets and suggest appropriate methods to  
  clean them.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Describe the role of feature scaling in data preprocessing and compare normalization  
  and standardization.                                                                       (5)  
  
  2)           Suppose you are working on an email spam detection system. Explain how supervised  
  learning and logistic regression can be used to classify emails as spam or not spam.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Consider a scenario where a bank wants to predict loan defaults. How can boosting  
  techniques like AdaBoost or Gradient Boosting help improve prediction accuracy?            (5)  
  
  3)           Explain the bias-variance tradeoff with the help of an example. Why is it important to  
  find the right balance?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain how the VC dimension of a hypothesis class helps in understanding the capacity  
  of a learning model. Provide an example.                                               (5)  
  
  4)           Explain the significance of clustering in real-world applications. Provide two examples  
  where clustering is used.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain how ICA is used in blind source separation problems, such as separating mixed  
  audio signals.                                                                        (5)  
  
  5)           Explain the Bellman equation, and how important is it in reinforcement learning?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Given a system with uncertainty and noise, how would you apply Linear Quadratic  
  Gaussian (LQG) control to improve decision-making?                                         (5)
